An English crib of the Latin text, semi-literal, made for this database in 2026 with Claude, a large language model (LLM) made by Anthropic. It keeps close to the wording of the original and uses the established English of Anglo-Latin legal, liturgical and canon-law formulae. It is an aid to reading the original, not a published translation. div.head: ECf 33.1
div.ab: In omnibus aliis causis et forisfacturis eandem legem habebant cum supradictis Norwensibus.
div.note: Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 661 (November 2026): read from the page images and checked against the scan’s own text layer, differences settled against the page.

note.seg: Verf. vermengt in C. 34 Dänen und Norweger, kennt also nicht etwa die vorwiegend Norwegische Besiedelung Nordbritanniens; auch sassen in Lincolnshire, das er dort in C. 30 nennt, mehr Dänen

in c. 34 the author mixes up Danes and Norwegians, so does not know, say, of the predominantly Norwegian settlement of northern Britain; also, in Lincolnshire, which he names there in c. 30, Danes were the more numerous
